text:

author: PC Gamer
text:

author: PC Gamer
text:
World of Warcraft: Forever won't destroy what made the old classes so satisfying by modernizing them into oblivion: 'The level of mechanical complexity found in the beta classes is indicative of our intentions'
You will wait patiently for your next ability and you will learn to love it.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Grand Theft Auto 6 rumored to be launching on PC sooner than anyone expected, but I wouldn't get my hopes up too high
If the rumored release window is accurate, it means the new GTA will hit PC just a few months after consoles—something almost unheard of from Rockstar.

text:

author: PC Gamer
text:

author: PC Gamer
text:

author: PC Gamer
text:

author: PC Gamer
text:

The animals are as beautiful as ever, but they're trapped in a cage of rote micromanagement.

text:

text:
